offending_extra_words: Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
reasons: Preferred cap is fully achieved: mutual greater-of cap with the exact fee basis ("fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim"), the USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and the full Excluded Claims carve-out list now sitting outside the cap.
Operation 2 is not needed to complete the preferred level. The original 21.3 already stated that Customer's payment obligation is not damages; only the cap sentence in 21.1 required amendment.

The rewrite of 21.3 works against us: deleting "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" means Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due — including disputed amounts and amounts for non-conforming Services — is expressly carved out of the liability limitation, removing a Customer-favourable qualifier and creating tension with any dispute or withholding rights elsewhere.
Recommend reverting 21.3 to its original wording and keeping only the 21.1 cap replacement.
